review: Reviewed launcher policy, experimental visibility preference, tab picker, panel host and registry differences plus complete launch/host tests. Reviewed the unchanged account policy cache, its tests and connection observation signal as dependencies.

Ordinary accounts default to the same product surface. Hidden launch entries are presentation choices; explicit locks and named operator-only panels remain enforced in the host. Legacy finite-policy fallback permits a known visible panel but never overrides an explicit lock. Server operations retain separate authority.

Experimental preference is browser-local and affects launch visibility only. Same-tab and storage events refresh subscribers; unavailable storage reads default to false. It does not change account type or operation permissions.

Account policy single-flight reads are invalidated by explicit profile observations and cross-tab events; stale responses cannot replace newer account state or clear a newer in-flight request. Profile revision signals clear dependent views without granting authority.

Panel host now remounts notes and calculator by profile identity. Registry adds the Physics Glyph workspace entry and renames Noise Gen for local music; registration alone does not certify an artifact or qualify a panel runtime.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; not a public release or installed acceptance.
Focused tests use mocked session HTTP responses and canonical dependency modules. No real account, grant, model, Minecraft or native operation was performed.
The full panel registry dynamically loads other panels, many of which remain separately reviewed dependencies. Selected-entry compilation is not a full website build or type check.

Experimental preference storage-denied behavior and cross-tab UI interactions were inspected but not qualified in a real browser. Notes/calculator profile remounting needs their dedicated persistence tests and installed checks.
Five intentional support-contact matches inherited from prior candidates remain in the final owner publication review.
